$comment: Produced by the Hearthmere environment kit pass, Claude Design, 2026-08-25.
Apply with a JSON-merge over the matching asset ids; nothing here changes
an id, a targetSlug, or a provenance record.
Two classes of amendment, kept separate on purpose:
A. materialSlots  — the asset's own declared purpose is unachievable at
the declared slot count. Two rows.
B. lodTriangles   — the structure rows were budgeted for a graybox. The
which is the ceiling the built geometry was authored
Every proposed number was measured, not estimated: the built LOD chain is
rebuilt at reduced parameters and counted, and no row exceeds the value

materialSlotAmendments.reason: REGION_ASSET_KITS.hearthmere.lighting.practicals is "banked_braziers". A declared practical light source cannot emit without an emissive material slot; at two slots the brazier is a cold bowl and the region loses its only warm practical.
The region is held at wetness 0.82 and the asset is named for catching rain. With two slots the barrel has a dry interior, which reads as a bug rather than as a barrel.

lodTriangleAmendments.$comment: budgetClass hero = WORLD_ASSET_BUDGETS.propTriangles.hero (48000); standard = 12000. LOD1/LOD2 proposed at the same 0.36 / 0.12 ratios the prop rows already use.

generatorAmendments.$comment: The graybox generators have been superseded by real procedural builders. Delivery is unchanged — sable-reach.prototype-assets.json already declares runtime-procedural-threejs.

rows.note: Still instanced at runtime — the change names the geometry generator, not the placement strategy.

proposedNewRows.$comment: Not amendments — three assets the authored fiction already requires and no manifest carries. Each is flagged 'proposed' in every surface that shows it.

rows.name: Blackpine, mature
rows.justification: worldAssets.js graven_march kit lists foliage "blackpine_mature", and world.js GATHER_NODES declares node_blackpine_01 "Harvestable Black Pine" at woodcutting 3. No asset row exists in any manifest. Carries its woodcutting face as geometry so a gatherable tree is legible before the prompt appears.

rows.name: Clay name tablet
rows.justification: The manifest carries hm.surface.clay-tablets as a SURFACE. world.js and the project README make the tablet the region's central object — "its people burn names into clay tablets so the dead cannot be forgotten by the ash" — and quest and codex surfaces need one that can be picked up. A surface cannot be held.

rows.name: Bell-clapper mace
rows.justification: world.js describes Torren Vale, Bell-Warden and Hearthmere's combat trainer, as "a broad veteran who carries the clapper of a ruined bell as a mace." He is a placed NPC with a named weapon and no weapon asset in any manifest.

textureAmendment.$comment: materials.maxTextureDimension is declared on every row and was unused, which is why the first pass read flat at close range. The six hm.surface.* rows now have real generators; their declared wetness has no PBR channel, so it is folded into a derived roughness map by one stated formula.
textureAmendment.exportCaveat: Textures survive the GLB export (glTF embeds them). They do NOT survive OBJ, which carries per-material colour only. That is a format limit, not a gap in the asset.

notApplied.$comment: Deliberately NOT amended, so the reader knows these were considered.
notApplied.propTriangleUplift: The ten hm.prop.* rows were left at their declared lodTriangles (6200 / 4800 / 3200 / 5400 / 1800 / 4400 / 1200 / 3900 / 4200 / 2200) rather than raised to the global 12000 standard ceiling. Every prop is under its own declared number, and raising fifteen rows to the global ceiling is a content-budget decision for a human, not a side effect of an art pass.
notApplied.vfxRows: The five hm.vfx.* rows are unbuilt. The living-world scene implements brazier fire and rain against the declared activeParticles cap of 2400, but spring_steam_low, bell_dust_pulse and lantern_moth_sparse have no generator yet.
